police.name: San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department - Morongo Basin Station
police.snippet: The San Bernardino County Sheriff's Department transitioned from providing police protection to the unincorporated area of Twentynine Palms to being an integral part of an incorporated community's contract police department in July of 1988.

court.court_name: Superior Court of California, County of San Bernardino
court.serves_note: Serves Twentynine Palms and surrounding areas including Joshua Tree, Landers, Pioneertown, and unincorporated areas of Johnson Valley, Morongo Valley, Yucca Valley
court.snippet: The Joshua Tree Court is located on the corner of Highway 62 and White Feather Road.
